svg.aria-label: Weights against decode rate, with decode on a log scale, coloured and shaped by class. The dotted line is the Pareto front (no model above it is both smaller and faster); the dashed vertical line at 14 GiB marks where weights alone have spent the budget, once the 1 GiB overhead is inside it. The MoE band sits above the dense band at every size: `lfm25-24b-a2b-think` decodes at 111 tok/s on 12.65 GiB while `mistral-24b-q4` manages 15 on 13.35

svg.desc: Weights against decode rate, with decode on a log scale, coloured and shaped by class. The dotted line is the Pareto front (no model above it is both smaller and faster); the dashed vertical line at 14 GiB marks where weights alone have spent the budget, once the 1 GiB overhead is inside it. The MoE band sits above the dense band at every size: `lfm25-24b-a2b-think` decodes at 111 tok/s on 12.65 GiB while `mistral-24b-q4` manages 15 on 13.35 — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
